item.title: Whittle
item.description: An AI agent that lives on your Android phone and gets things done. Bring any model and your own keys, with no Whittle server in between.

item.title: Meh.ai
item.description: A Chrome extension for asking questions about the page you’re on, summarizing it and pulling out key points, with Gemini Nano running on-device. Built for the Google Chrome Built-in AI Challenge.

item.title: OpenVoice Streaming Server
